acceptance.note: The 'cannot be merged' half depends on the required status check `ci-ok` in branch protection (AC-M0-03, manual).

acceptance.actual: Not configured: needs a repository admin in GitHub settings. Exact steps and the probe procedure: docs/setup/branch-protection.md.

known_limitations: CI has not run on GitHub yet; the first run is triggered by this push. Action SHAs are pinned from `git ls-remote` (checkout v7.0.1, setup-uv v10.4.0, setup-python v6.3.0).

Lockfiles: the root uv.lock pins the workspace (kit, approval, gxg-policy). connectors/demo has its own uv.lock per demo-connector-v1.md / mcp-toolkit-v1.md ('lockfile of every connector') and is pulled into the root by path only to run its tests. CI checks both lockfiles with `uv lock --check`. When demo starts depending on gxg-connector-kit (M3), it needs a path source to ../../packages/gxg-connector-kit.
Any normative schema change needs `uv run python scripts/ci/schema_lock.py --write` in the same PR. This is deliberate: weakening becomes visible in review.
The secret scanner is local and pattern-based (names + PEM private keys). It does not detect arbitrary API tokens; a full scanner (e.g. gitleaks) can be added later.
